templates.why_chosen: Three motivating vignettes (A multi-agent workflows, B multiple fine-tuned models, C personalized agents) reuse one visual grammar, a shared source fanning into separate purple/green boxes, each needlessly reprocessing the same content.
templates.what_to_learn: Repeat one simple visual grammar (a shared input fanning into separate coloured boxes) across several real-world vignettes to argue a problem is general, even when each vignette's icons differ; but label what the colours mean on the first panel, since leaving it unstated across all three forces the reader to guess.
